# sjsebastian-substack-style

- **URL:** https://sjsebastian.substack.com/archive (+ /p/the-narcissistic-injury-of-artificial, /p/distinction-after-the-human, /p/against-the-sentimental-critics-of, /p/after-bureaucracy) · **Accessed:** 2026-07-30 · **For:** v1 review, venue calibration
- **What it establishes:** The target venue's identity and house style. Publication: "S. J. Sebastian — Philosophy, cultural commentary, the history of ideas." Seven substantive essays (Oct 2025–Jul 2026), mostly on AI, organizations, and the history of ideas.
- **House style, distilled:**
  - Roman-numeral sections with descriptive conceptual headers; occasional epigraphs.
  - Declarative, aphoristic openings ("AI does not overturn modernity; it completes it") followed by subordinate-heavy elaboration; waves of assertion → development.
  - Impersonal, authoritative voice; first person rare and strategic (used once to establish credibility in "After Bureaucracy"); "we" as universal subject.
  - Elevated latinate diction with strategic colloquial grounding; abstract nouns; no jargon walls.
  - Citation practice: essentially NONE — epigraphs and in-text name-checks (Heidegger, Bourdieu, Marx) without formal apparatus. (The writer has overridden this for the current piece: [n] endnote citations required.)
  - Rhetorical signatures: inversion/paradox, redefinition, historical periodization, analogy chains, categorical policing ("category error"), prophetic closing cadence.
  - Tone: diagnostic, grave, assured, "diagnosis rather than prescription," slightly contemptuous of muddled opposition but clinical rather than accusatory.
- **Reliability:** Primary (the venue itself).
- **Relevance:** The v1 draft already approximates this register (declarative compression, roman numerals, impersonal authority). Key deltas to check in Phase 4: v1 is more listy/manual-like than any published essay at the venue (tables, bulleted lexicons, rules of use); the venue's pieces are continuous argumentative prose. Also v1 lacks the venue's characteristic historical-genealogical periodization until §VIII–IX; venue essays front-load it. Watch for "It is not X, it is Y" density — a venue signature but also an AI-cadence reception risk at high frequency.
- **Representative venue sentences (verbatim):** "What troubles us is the mirror they hold up to our civilization." / "The soul learned to think of itself as a factory." / "To say 'AI makes us dumber' is therefore not an empirical claim about outcomes. It is a performative act of differentiation." / "Behind every prompt stands a human will." / "When the time it takes to obtain alignment is longer than the time it takes to prototype the answer, the culture that valorizes alignment becomes self-parody."
